subject: ribbon-jointed fox doll
art_direction: 木狐玩偶用短丝带作关节，扁平大尾盘在身侧，橘红与湖蓝手绘色块突出。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Carve a fox doll with a long wedge-soft muzzle, compact triangular ears, and an oversized flat tail curled beside its seated body. Join the short limbs with visible lengths of silk ribbon rather than hinges. Paint the wood in terracotta and lagoon-blue blocks, leaving some pale grain exposed along the cheeks. The fox looks back toward the viewer with a small pleased expression. Use warm ivory surroundings and one low directional shadow. Keep the ribbons close to the body, with no marionette strings, forest scenery, or realistic fur. Square 1024x1024. Keep the complete central silhouette within a circular crop, occupying about 70% of the canvas. Original design; no lettering, logos, or watermark.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
